课程简介（中文）

本课程以泰国歌曲为媒介，介绍泰国语言与泰国文化。课程面向零基础学生，无需具备任何泰语学习背景。通过精心挑选不同时期、不同类型的泰国歌曲，将听力、语音、词汇学习与文化理解有机结合，使学生在音乐情境中接触并学习基础泰语。

课程内容涵盖泰语基本语音、文字基础、日常表达，以及歌曲中所呈现的爱情、身份认同、社会生活、传统文化等主题。通过以音乐为基础的学习方式，学生将在轻松、互动的课堂环境中逐步培养泰语语言意识、基础语言运用能力以及跨文化理解与文化敏感度。

课程简介（英文）

This course introduces the Thai language and culture through the medium of Thai songs. Designed for students with no prior knowledge of Thai, the course integrates listening, pronunciation, vocabulary acquisition, and cultural understanding through carefully selected songs from different genres and periods.

Students will explore Thai sounds, script basics, everyday expressions, and cultural themes such as love, identity, society, and traditions. Through music-based learning, students will develop both linguistic awareness and cultural sensitivity in an engaging and interactive environment.

教学目标

By the end of the course, students will be able to:

  1. Recognize and pronounce basic Thai sounds and tones
  2. Understand key vocabulary and simple sentence structures from songs
  3. Interpret the meaning and cultural context of Thai songs
  4. Identify elements of Thai culture reflected in music (e.g., values, relationships, social norms)
  5. Develop listening skills in Thai through repeated exposure
  6. Perform or creatively present Thai songs with basic understanding
  7. Build confidence in engaging with a new language through music

教学方式

The course uses Thai songs as a primary tool for language and cultural learning, allowing students to understand and practice Thai through authentic and engaging materials. A student-centered and communicative approach will be adopted, with interactive activities such as listening tasks, group discussions, lyric exploration, pronunciation practice, games, and creative activities. Students will be encouraged to use newly learned language immediately and comfortably exchange ideas about the cultural themes presented in the songs. The course emphasizes active participation and creates a supportive, low-pressure environment where students can develop their Thai language skills and cultural understanding through meaningful interaction.

教学内容与进度安排

Week 1: Introduction to Thai Language & Music

  • Course overview
  • Introduction to Thai sounds and tones
  • Why learn Thai through songs?
  • Ice-breaking activity with simple Thai phrases

Week 2: Thai Sounds & Pronunciation

  • Consonants and vowels (basic exposure)
  • Tone awareness through melody
  • Song: Simple children’s song

Week 3: Greetings & Everyday Expressions

  • Basic phrases (hello, thank you, sorry)
  • Song theme: Daily life
  • Listening + sing-along

Week 4: Love & Emotions in Thai Songs

  • Vocabulary of emotions
  • Cultural expression of love
  • Song analysis (slow tempo)

Week 5: Sentence Patterns through Lyrics

  • Basic sentence structure
  • Repetition in songs
  • Guided lyric breakdown

 

Week 6: Thai Pop Culture (T-Pop)

  • Modern Thai music trends
  • Slang and informal language
  • Song activity + discussion

Week 7: Storytelling through Songs

  • Narrative structure
  • Interpreting meaning
  • Group discussion

Week 8: Midterm Review & Mini Performance

  • Review key vocabulary and sounds
  • Group singing / presentation
  • Midterm Assessment

Week 9: Thai Script Introduction (Optional Light Exposure)

  • Basic consonant recognition
  • Matching sounds to script
  • Song lyric reading (guided)

Week 10: Regional Identity in Music

  • Introduction to regional styles (Isan, Northern, Southern)
  • Cultural diversity in songs

Week 11: Social Themes in Thai Songs

  • Songs about society, life, and values
  • Discussion-based learning

Week 12: Thai Festivals & Traditional Songs

  • Songkran, Loy Krathong songs
  • Cultural meanings behind music

Week 13: Creative Interpretation

  • Students reinterpret song meaning
  • Visual / storytelling activity

Week 14: Final Project Preparation

  • Project consultation
  • Practice sessions (performance / presentation)

Week 15: Final Project Presentation

  • Individual or group presentations
  • Performance / analysis / creative output

Week 16: Final Exam

  • Listening + interpretation
  • Basic vocabulary recognition
  • Reflection on learning
